def compute_a_n(N):
    a = [0] * (N + 1)
    a[1] = 0

    for n in range(2, N + 1):
        max_val = -float('inf')
        for i in range(1, n):
            # Term is a_i + a_{n-i} + min(i, n-i)
            current_val = a[i] + a[n - i] + min(i, n - i)
            if current_val > max_val:
                max_val = current_val
        a[n] = max_val
    return a[1:]

# Compute up to N=15
results = compute_a_n(15)
print("n:", list(range(1, 16)))
print("a_n:", results)
